limitations.statement: The selected ROI5_C1 point and the terrain-shadow classification are team-derived research choices using NASA-sourced inputs; NASA did not select, approve, or validate a MoonBase coordinate.
limitations.impact: The snapshot cannot be described as a NASA-approved habitat or solar-array location.

limitations.statement: The local terrain calculation uses a documented DEM ray trace and a spherical inverse of the PGDA projected map, not a SPICE DSK surface model.
limitations.impact: Frame and map-model assumptions require scientific review before any operational interpretation.

limitations.statement: ORIGINAL, CLONE_001, CLONE_050, and CLONE_100 were evaluated. The three clones are a representative sensitivity run, not a complete 100-clone uncertainty analysis.
limitations.impact: No statistical confidence percentage or complete clone-distribution claim is allowed.

limitations.statement: The 15-minute time-series windows contain sampled timestamps only.
limitations.impact: First/last sampled shadow times must not be rewritten as exact continuous transition boundaries.

limitations.statement: PGDA terrain rasters are 5 m/pixel products and the PGDA README describes substantial interpolation; LDEC is an observation-count indicator, not direct-measurement proof for every pixel.
limitations.impact: Pixel-scale geometry and shadow margins must be interpreted with the retained uncertainty and LDEC context.

limitations.statement: No panel geometry, orientation, efficiency, degradation, operating state, electrical load, battery model, or validated array hardware is part of this package.
limitations.impact: No watts, watt-hours, battery capacity, power-loss percentage, or electrical output may be derived from this evidence.

limitations.statement: The snapshot contains no measured solar-array telemetry, no lunar habitat operating record, and no direct surface radiation or power measurement at ROI5_C1.
limitations.impact: The result supports sunlight obstruction only.

limitations.statement: Phase 3 validation does not rerun the original astronomical calculation.
limitations.impact: A validator PASS is snapshot-integrity and replay-fixture validation, not full scientific calculation reproduction.

limitations.statement: The incomplete Phase 1 local LDEC copy is preserved only as an excluded artifact and is never a frozen input.
limitations.impact: Any future analysis must use the complete LDEC hash recorded in this package.

limitations.statement: MoonBase, its fictional solar equipment, POWER DROP event, player choices, and abstract resources remain game-design concepts outside this scientific package.
limitations.impact: This freeze does not change playable behavior or justify a gameplay rule change.

required_future_review: Independent review of the projected-map-to-MOON_ME_DE421 transformation.
Full available clone inventory and statistical uncertainty method if a confidence statement is required.
Independent rerun of the SPICE and DEM ray trace with the frozen hashes and parameters.
Separate engineering model before any electrical-power interpretation.
